title: Deployment Mix — Savings Explorer
summary: High-level scenario explorer that models 3-year TCO for on‑prem, VPC, and hybrid mixes. Focus on capacity rebalancing recommendations and license/support bundle optimizations. Includes amortization, NPV back-of-envelope, and sensitivity runs for utilization and spot vs reserved mix.
assumptions: GPU list price used: p4d-equivalent at $32k/unit CAPEX
Average utilization scenarios: low 35%, mid 60%, high 85%
Network egress for VPC estimated at $0.02/token-equivalent unit (modelled as bytes converted)
License fee (platform) baseline: $200k/year for enterprise bundle; per-seat add-on $1000/year
Support bundles: Standard (10% license), Premium (20% license), Enterprise (30% license incl. 24/7 oncall)
